verdicts.reason: In both, the kraft boxes, cup and fortune cookies are cropped away, leaving only a sliver of orange at the bottom edge, and the two rules that framed the text block now sit far off at the very top and bottom edges. A at least keeps 'Order online' larger than 'food & drinks', but the big gaps scatter the group across dead grey space. B flips the hierarchy: the italic 'food & drinks' is now much bigger than the headline, with '&' stranded on its own line and the text nearly touching the sides.
